violation_control.description: shape-only validator (NULLs and Python types; no enum/range/unique/freshness)

negative_controls.note: Controls are intentionally weaker detectors. Their lower scores show the headline metrics measure the real detectors, not the harness.

known_blind_spots.case: rename of an entirely NULL column
known_blind_spots.why: no name resemblance and no values to compare; the two versions are observationally identical
known_blind_spots.mitigation: submit an explicit `renamed_from` hint; the diff engine honours it at confidence 1.0

known_blind_spots.case: value swap between two identically-declared columns
known_blind_spots.why: the declaration is unchanged by the swap; nothing declares which column means what
known_blind_spots.mitigation: declare a cross-field expression rule (e.g. `created_at <= updated_at`); the sampler catches it as a data violation

known_blind_spots.case: semantic meaning change under an unchanged shape
known_blind_spots.why: `status='paid'` silently meaning something new is not a schema change at all
known_blind_spots.mitigation: attach a business rule or data predicate to the contract; contract review at submission is the only real safeguard

known_blind_spots.case: declared type change when the sample predates the change
known_blind_spots.why: value-level evidence is absent, so only declaration diffing applies
known_blind_spots.mitigation: declaration diffing always runs and does catch it; the sample is used for renames, not type decisions
